method: Belize's three atolls: Turneffe Atoll, Lighthouse Reef (Great Blue Hole, Half Moon Caye, Long Caye) and Glover's Reef, as dived by atoll resorts and by day trips from Ambergris Caye, Caye Caulker, Hopkins and Placencia. Official lists, one each: the Half Moon Caye and Blue Hole Natural Monuments management plan 2008-2013 (Map 19, popular dive sites) for Lighthouse Reef and the Glover's Reef Marine Reserve management plan 2008-2013 (its tourism section's named dive sites) for Glover's; the Turneffe Atoll management plan 2012-2017 maps its dive sites as unnamed dots, so Turneffe has no official named list. Operator lists, one each: Turneffe Flats, Blackbird Caye Resort, Ramon's Village, Frenchie's Diving, Ecologic Divers, Amigos del Mar, Belize Pro Dive Center, White Sands Dive Shop, Ambergris Divers, Hamanasi (its Turneffe, Lighthouse, Glover's pages and its site blog are one list), Thatch Caye Resort, Splash Dive Center, Seahorse Dive Shop (belizescuba.com), The Placencia Resort, Belize Adventures (Slickrock, Long Caye, Glover's) and Off the Wall (Glover's). The Belize Tourism Board's two diving articles count together as one list. Turneffe Island Resort's site did not resolve, Isla Marisol's domain did not resolve and Glover's Atoll Resort names no sites; Island Expeditions, Dive The World, Belize Adventure (a blog) and Wikipedia were read for leads only. A site is counted when it is named, recreationally divable on scuba and on at least two lists. The Great Blue Hole is counted as the ~40 m (130 ft) guided dive run for certified divers. The Lighthouse Aquarium and Long Caye Wall are one row because Amigos and Seahorse name them as one site; Glover's Long Caye Wall and Aquarium are separate rows. One-list and official-only names stay as excluded rows. Counted 2026-10-14.
